scope: Follow up the 114-run Day One friction audit with a one-finger picture prompt after three active seconds without progress. Use one live target and its existing action or visual demonstration. Hide help during valid progress, actor travel, pause, focus loss and scene replacement. A stationary held finger sees the hint after the stall window. The hint becomes tappable on release.

route_coverage.help: Offer the clip's existing Skip action after the stall window. Preserve its existing ownership and authored cuts.

route_coverage.moment: Lagoon castle gate and optional playground ride
route_coverage.help: Point to the castle gate and use its existing entry. Offer Back during the playground ride to request its normal settle.
Reinforce the real Back action, then point to the next glowing door. Each control retains its local route.

route_coverage.moment: Bathroom basket, sink, tub drain, tub brush and toilet
route_coverage.help: Tap the basket or drain through its current handler. The scrub hints replay the existing motions, and only a live scrub earns progress.

route_coverage.moment: Pool skimmer, waterfall, seahorse and celebration
route_coverage.help: A deliberate help tap asks for one scoop, one partial strip scrub or one tug through the existing contact rules. The earned pool reveal keeps its full voice before the clip. Skip becomes available once the clip owns input.
Point to one live rescue pin, then to confirmation of the currently selected friend.

route_coverage.moment: Art Studio pickup, grime and paint desk
route_coverage.help: Point to the next loose supply, grime spot, desk or confirmation. A selected supply brightens and answers at once as Roshan travels. The item enters the save at its original contact and storage completion.

route_coverage.moment: Grand Puff greeting, first floor move, dodge, open star and between-round pause
route_coverage.help: Offer the greeting shortcut once speech has ended, then use the current floor or star target. Help is inactive during strike, travel and ending beats.
